dedupe_keys.name: virginia zero energy commercial building measurements

description: This OSF project publishes observations from a 328-square-metre all-electric, zero-energy commercial building in Virginia, United States. The research team describes over two years of hourly circuit-level energy use and over six years of solar production measured by 56 microinverters. It also supplies post-construction pressurisation and depressurisation air-leakage results, weather information and architectural and engineering documents. The own page lists Excel workbooks for HVAC, lighting, plug and process loads and the whole building, under CC0 with free access. These observations can calibrate building simulations such as model-energyplus and complement the larger data-building-data-genome-2 collection. A caveat is that one building's occupancy, equipment and controls do not represent general commercial stock. Solar measurements were collected hourly, but users should check the released workbook's aggregation before aligning it with demand. The documentation and visible file inventory were inspected without signing in; no workbook, drawing or weather file was downloaded.
